rationale: The source explicitly defines Rowan m02 as the positive case and Mica m02 as the tolerated control, while the candidate reverses both case roles and the comparison membership. This is material because the tested hypothesis is a discriminator across the positive-versus-tolerated-control contrast: Rowan has Quartz=high with the outcome, whereas Mica has Quartz=low without it. Reversing the represented comparison can invert or invalidate the hard contrast evaluation and therefore can change whether the conclusion that Quartz survives the represented comparison is permitted, even though the individual observations and feature values remain source-faithful.
